newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea arrests 38 people for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: South Korea arrests 38 people for drug smuggling.

text.p: South Korea has arrested 38 people, some of them foreigners, for smuggling narcotics worth about 39.5 billion won ($47.7 million), state prosecutors said on Monday.

They said they had discovered 11 drug trafficking rings comprising 57 people that operated in South Korea and several foreign countries, including the United States, Japan, Hong Kong, China and the Philippines.
Police were still trying to arrest 13 members of the drug trafficking rings. Three foreigners have already been deported and three South Koreans were being questioned, it said.
A prosecution statement said the 57 included a total of 16 foreigners, but did not say how many of the foreigners had been arrested.
The rings had smuggled a total of 39.5 billion won worth of cocaine, heroin, cannabis and other drugs to South Korea this year, prosecutors said.
South Korea bans the trafficking of narcotics. The offence carries a maximum penalty of death by hanging.
